history.summary: IDENTITY: verified as entry #5 'Shiv Mandir, B - II', sub-division Mangan, on the Sikkim Ecclesiastical Department's official district-wise list of Hindu mandirs - it is a real Shiva shrine in the Mangan area. What 'B-II' denotes is unverified - it reads as a block/colony or ward designation within Mangan (e.g. a settlement quarter), but no source confirms this. No independent web source mentions the mandir, so its architecture, age and management are undocumented. The geocoder resolves a 'Shiv Temple, Mangan 737116' a few kilometres south of Mangan town, which is used as an approximate coordinate - treat as approximate, flagged.

name: Shiv Mandir, B-II
town_description: Mangan is the headquarters of Mangan district (North Sikkim), about 65 km from Gangtok, and the base town for travel into North Sikkim (Lachung, Lachen, Gurudongmar Lake), set above the Teesta river valley.

travel.airport: Bagdogra Airport, West Bengal, about 146 km via Rangpo-Singtam-Dikchu (per darjeeling-tourism.com; verify).
travel.railway: New Jalpaiguri (NJP) Station, West Bengal, about 138 km (per darjeeling-tourism.com; verify).
travel.road: About 65 km from Gangtok (about 2 hrs 45 min); regular shared jeeps and buses from Gangtok's Vajra taxi stand.

visitor_information.best_time: March to May and October to December, the usual Sikkim season.
